bio.text: Willie Preston is a Democratic member of the Illinois Senate for the 16th District, serving since 2023, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

The legislature biography says he was born and raised in Chicago, lives in the Auburn Gresham neighborhood, and worked as a union carpenter before attending Chicago State University and Roosevelt University.
It also says he served on the Local School Council at Scott Joplin Elementary and on the board of a Chicagoland YMCA early childhood education program, and that he operates a construction firm.
